task.title: Verify Wi-Fi network configuration
task.shortdesc: This section describes the process of verifying the Wi-Fi access point, the Wi-Fi security type,

context.p: This section describes the process of verifying the Wi-Fi access point, the Wi-Fi security type, and the network availability at the motor location.

The requires internet connectivity to send data to the . To connect an to the internet, you must use the plant’s local Wi-Fi network. The can only be connected to a Wi-Fi network that is password-protected and enabled 24/7.
The supports the following network configuration:
context.note: If your network does not meet the above requirements, you can use a Wi-Fi router to connect an to the . For more information, see Recommendations to purchase a router .

step.cmd: Check the settings on the back of the router. Verify that the Wi-Fi access point is 2.4GHz 802.11b/n/g.
Go to the Wi-Fi settings on your mobile device.
Select the Wi-Fi name to see the security type. Ensure that the Wi-Fi security is either WEP, WPA, or WPA2.

info.p: To verify Wi-Fi network availability at the motor location:

step.cmd: Open the Wi-Fi settings in your mobile device to see if the local Wi-Fi network is available.

result.p: Note: The minimal Wi-Fi signal strength must be greater than -60dB at the motor location.
